svg.desc: A left-to-right flowchart. First check the loss at step 0 against the base-rate entropy; if wrong, suspect labels, loss or output scale. Then overfit one batch; if it cannot, suspect the model or loop. Then inspect gradient norms per layer; zero means a broken graph, NaN or huge means numerics. Only then tune the learning rate, data and capacity.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The loss won't go down: cheapest check first

svg.text: Each check rules out a whole class of bugs before you touch hyper-parameters.
